about: Touched-path → test-suite map (bothouse#236), read by `botq test-map`. The acceptance gate derives a landed change's touched paths from its own diff and requires the commands mapped here green. First matching rule wins: specific rules above broad ones. `tests: []` means CONSCIOUSLY untested and must carry its why. An unmapped path fails the resolver loud. Commands run from the repo root; lint completeness with `botq test-map --check`.

rules.why: editing the map re-lints its own completeness over every tracked file
prose, licenses and the evidence snapshot — nothing executes them, and the snapshot is regenerated by the GPU suite rather than read by it
the launcher is three lines of shell and nothing else runs it; shellcheck is the only check there is short of a television
the pinned dev environment: parsing catches a syntax error, and a build inside it catches a package the toolchain or the wgpu/winit runtime actually needed

one crate, one suite. The WGSL rides the same rule because nothing parses it until a pipeline is built, which only the GPU tests in tests/ do — a shader typo is a runtime error, so `cargo build` alone would pass it
